confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: Set up {name} for local Bluetooth control.

abort.cannot_identify: The advertisement did not contain a stable window name.
abort.no_devices_found: No connectable Atmoph Window is currently visible.

duplicate_device_uuid.message: This window reports the same device UUID as {name}, which is already set up. Remove one of the two entries.

no_window_targeted.message: No loaded Atmoph Window was targeted. Choose the window to act on.

setting_not_reported.message: The window has not reported a range for this setting yet.

unknown_command.message: {command} is not an Atmoph remote-control command. Known commands are: {commands}.

unknown_setting.message: {setting} is not an Atmoph quick setting. Known settings are: {settings}.

value_out_of_range.message: {value} is outside the range the window reports for this setting ({minimum} to {maximum}).

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Sends one remote-control command to a window, including the commands that have no button.

command.name: Command
command.description: The command to send. Double tap and search have no button of their own.

set_setting.name: Set quick setting
set_setting.description: Writes one of the window's quick-menu settings, including the ones with no entity.

setting.name: Setting
setting.description: The quick-menu setting to write, named as the window reports it.

value.name: Value
value.description: A number for a level, or true or false for a switch. A level is checked against the range the window reports.
